title: Jacques Vallée's control system: beings with us for thousands of years

tellings.quote: if you talk to Jacques Valle, he would say that they've been with us for thousands of years and they're sort of controlling like the earth in many ways

plain: Some beings have been with humans for thousands of years and are in many ways controlling the Earth: that is the view Michels credits to Jacques Vallée, a computer scientist and longtime UFO researcher. Michels gives this as his own summary of what Vallée would say, not as a quote from him.
